name: Luna
author: salmun-nister
description: Lunar companion for the Omarchy bar: a live moon phase pill with a stylized popup showing illumination, moon age, full-moon names, date scrubbing, and next full/new moon dates. Six art styles including Unicode Braille, a 1930s rubber-hose moon, and sculpted clay, with lunar eclipse shadows, stage times, and alerts.

barWidget.description: Moon phase pill with a stylized lunar art popup
